geopolitics_summary: EU Russia sanctions package clinched after Greek concession on gas shipping; NATO fuel network overhaul agreed. Strait of Hormuz patrol push meets allied resistance.

themes.headline: Greek gas concession unlocks EU's Russia sanctions package deal
themes.why_it_matters: Resolution of shipping Russian gas dispute and 12-month freeze on crude price cap directly affects TTF hedging, sanctions risk premium, and LNG import arbitrage for EU buyers.

themes.headline: NATO seals €27B overhaul of Cold War-era fuel network across 32 members
themes.why_it_matters: Multi-decade military fuel infrastructure upgrade affects geopolitical stability and potential energy supply chain resilience; indirect power-grid security implications for NATO allies.

themes.headline: Energia Costa Azul Mexico LNG terminal ships first cargo, adds 0.4 Bcf/d capacity
themes.why_it_matters: Mexico's second LNG export facility increases global LNG supply, moderating US LNG export prices and improving European LNG import arb economics, supporting lower TTF.

themes.headline: Spain wildfires displace 100k+, expose firefighting gaps amid political tensions
themes.why_it_matters: Large-scale fires risk Iberian thermal/hydro asset damage, transmission line outages, and grid stability. Demand surge from emergency response and heatwave could support DA/Cal+1 spreads.

themes.headline: Trump bans foreign-made robots, power inverters citing Chinese espionage, blackout risks
themes.why_it_matters: US protectionist measures on power gear may disrupt global supply chains for inverters and grid equipment; indirect risk to EU renewable interconnect timelines and infrastructure costs.
